Landmark ruler (fixed for every garment; L/R = WEARER'S left/right; a point between two landmarks is written "A..B:t", t from 0 at A to 1 at B):
neck/shoulder: NP_x neck points (side of the neck, top of the shoulder line); SP_x shoulder tips; FSH_x/BSH_x mid-shoulder slightly front/back; CFN centre-front neck (crew height), CFN_LOW low front neck; CBN nape, CBN_LOW low back neck; NECK_SIDE_x base of the neck at the side (for collar stands);
torso: UA_x underarm (top of side seam); CHEST_x chest (pocket height), CHEST_C centre chest; BUST_C centre front under the bust; BUSTSIDE_x; SB_x shoulder blades; UB_C centre upper back; YOKE_x back yoke at the armhole; MB_x side at mid-back, MB_C centre back mid-back; WL_x waist at the side, WF_C/WB_C centre front/back waist; HIP_x hip at the side, HIP_C_F/HIP_C_B; HEM_x hem of a top at the side (hip length), HEM_FC/HEM_BC centre front/back hem;
tailoring: BREAK centre front where lapels meet (top button); LAPEL_TIP_x lapel point; GORGE_x the notch where collar meets lapel;
sleeves: SSLV_OUT_x/SSLV_IN_x short-sleeve end outer/inner; ELB_OUT_x/ELB_IN_x elbow; WRIST_OUT_x/WRIST_IN_x long-sleeve end outer/inner;
hood: HOOD_FRONT_x middle of the hood's front edge; HOOD_TOP top of the hood; HOOD_BACK back of the hood; HOOD_SIDE_x; HOOD_CROWN_F;
pockets: FPK_TOP_x/FPK_SIDE_x ends of a trouser front-pocket scoop; BPK_x back pocket centre; KANG_x/KANG_LOW_x corners of a kangaroo pocket;
lower body: CROTCH (inseam top), CROTCH_F/CROTCH_B; KNEE_OUT_x/KNEE_IN_x; ANKLE_OUT_x/ANKLE_IN_x; LEG_HEM_F_x/LEG_HEM_B_x middle of a leg hem front/back; SHORT_OUT_x/SHORT_IN_x/SHORT_HEM_F_x/SHORT_HEM_B_x shorts hem; SKIRT_HEM_x skirt hem at the side (knee), SKIRT_HEM_C_F/SKIRT_HEM_C_B.
Trousers/skirts start at the waist (WL_x, WF_C, WB_C); tops end at HEM_x or shorter (e.g. "UA_L..HEM_L:0.6").

JOIN LIST (the construction; every view must agree with it):
- neck_binding: binding (narrow) from NP_R..SP_R:0.3 → CFN → NP_L..SP_L:0.3. continues into strap_from_L, strap_from_R, armhole_L, armhole_R. High crew-height front neck binding, front only; at each neck point it turns into a back strap.
- armhole_L: binding (narrow) from NP_L..SP_L:0.3 → SP_L..UA_L:0.4 → UA_L. continues into neck_binding, back_opening_edge. Deep cut-in (racer-style) front armhole, bound, running from the neck point down to the underarm.
- armhole_R: binding (narrow) from NP_R..SP_R:0.3 → SP_R..UA_R:0.4 → UA_R. continues into neck_binding, back_opening_edge. Mirror of armhole_L.
- strap_from_L: strap (wide) from NP_L..SP_L:0.3 → UB_C..MB_C:0.2 → UA_R..MB_R:0.4. continues into neck_binding. Folded double-layer strap; runs over the left shoulder and diagonally across the back to the right side. Lies on top at the crossing.
- strap_from_R: strap (wide) from NP_R..SP_R:0.3 → UB_C..MB_C:0.2 → UA_L..MB_L:0.4. continues into neck_binding. Folded double-layer strap; runs over the right shoulder and diagonally across the back to the left side. Crosses strap_from_L at UB_C, underneath.
- back_opening_edge: binding (narrow) from UA_L..MB_L:0.4 → MB_C → UA_R..MB_R:0.4. Curved, bound upper edge of the back body at mid-back, with a small tack at MB_C.
- back_opening: OPENING (no cloth) bounded by strap_from_L, strap_from_R, back_opening_edge. Open back below and around the cross; bare skin shows.
- side_seam_L: seam from UA_L → WL_L → HEM_L. continues into armhole_L, hem_front, hem_back. Side seam.
- side_seam_R: seam from UA_R → WL_R → HEM_R. continues into armhole_R, hem_front, hem_back. Side seam.
- hem_front: edge from HEM_L → HEM_FC → HEM_R. continues into side_seam_L, side_seam_R. Narrow rolled or raw lettuce-like hem at hip length.
- hem_back: edge from HEM_R → HEM_BC → HEM_L. continues into side_seam_L, side_seam_R. Back hem.
- inner_layer_V: edge from NP_R..SP_R:0.2 → BUST_C..WF_C:0.4 → NP_L..SP_L:0.2. continues into neck_binding. Edge of the opaque inner front layer, visible through the sheer outer layer. Its V point sits just below the bust; the inner layer is caught into the neck binding.
ABSENT (do not draw): no sleeves; no back neckline or back neck binding (the straps replace it); no shoulder seam visible on the outside; no closures; no pockets; no collar; no centre-front seam on the outer layer; no cloth in the upper back between the straps

CHECK EVERY VIEW AGAINST THESE BEFORE DRAWING:
- strap_from_L: its top end sits ON THE SHOULDER LINE, 30% of the way from the neck point NP_L towards the shoulder tip SP_L (NP_L..SP_L:0.3); NOT at the neck point and NOT at the shoulder tip.
- strap_from_R: its top end sits ON THE SHOULDER LINE, 30% of the way from the neck point NP_R towards the shoulder tip SP_R (NP_R..SP_R:0.3); NOT at the neck point and NOT at the shoulder tip.
- strap_from_L runs DIAGONALLY across the back from NP_L..SP_L:0.3 to UA_R..MB_R:0.4 on the OPPOSITE side, as one straight band.
- strap_from_R runs DIAGONALLY across the back from NP_R..SP_R:0.3 to UA_L..MB_L:0.4 on the OPPOSITE side, as one straight band.
- strap_from_L and strap_from_R cross each other once, BELOW the neck points (between the shoulder blades), never above the neckline.
- There is NO back neckline: neck_binding runs across the FRONT only. On the FRONT view draw NOTHING behind or inside the front neck band (no back-neck arc, no second curve). On the BACK view draw NOTHING between the tops of the bands at the neck points — no neckline, no band, no line.
- neck_binding starts at NP_R..SP_R:0.3 and stops at NP_L..SP_L:0.3; it does not continue past them.
- armhole_L starts at NP_L..SP_L:0.3 and stops at UA_L; it does not continue past them.
- armhole_R starts at NP_R..SP_R:0.3 and stops at UA_R; it does not continue past them.
- back_opening_edge starts at UA_L..MB_L:0.4 and stops at UA_R..MB_R:0.4; it does not continue past them.
- The area bounded by strap_from_L, strap_from_R, back_opening_edge is OPEN: leave it white — no cloth, no panel, no line across it.
- Draw NOTHING for: no sleeves.
- Draw NOTHING for: no back neckline or back neck binding (the straps replace it).
- Draw NOTHING for: no shoulder seam visible on the outside.
- Draw NOTHING for: no closures.
- Draw NOTHING for: no pockets.
- Draw NOTHING for: no collar.
- Draw NOTHING for: no centre-front seam on the outer layer.
- Draw NOTHING for: no cloth in the upper back between the straps.
- SIDE LEFT shows the wearer's LEFT flank with the front facing the LEFT edge of its frame; SIDE RIGHT is its mirror with the front facing the RIGHT edge.
- The FRONT neckline is a HIGH CREW neck at the centre front: neck_binding is a narrow band from NP_R..SP_R:0.3 over CFN (crew height at the centre front, just below the collarbone notch) to NP_L..SP_L:0.3; its ends sit exactly where those points are, away from the base of the neck — NOT a V, NOT a plunge, NOT a halter ring, NOT a scoop.
- The outer front layer is CLOSED cloth from the neck binding down to the hem; there is no cut-out and no open V in the front. inner_layer_V is the edge of the opaque inner layer seen THROUGH the sheer outer layer: draw it as a FINE DASHED line only, from NP_R..SP_R:0.2 down to its point just below the bust and back up to NP_L..SP_L:0.2.
- armhole_L and armhole_R bindings are on the FRONT view only (deep cut-in racer-style armhole from the shoulder line 30% of the way out from the neck point towards the shoulder tip, NOT from the neck point, down to the underarm); on the BACK view the straps themselves are the only edges above the back opening.
- back_opening_edge is ONE smooth U-shaped binding across the back at mid-back level, from UA_L..MB_L:0.4 down through MB_C and up to UA_R..MB_R:0.4; the lower ends of the straps are sewn to it at its two top ends.
- In SIDE LEFT and SIDE RIGHT the strap is ONE smooth continuous band: from the front neck binding up over the top of the shoulder and down the back to the back opening edge — no loop, knot, hook, fold or notch; behind the strap the back body starts only at mid-back height (open back), while the front body starts at the neck.
